question: What forms of knowledge and bliss constitute the supreme Brahman addressed to the goddess?
premises: The supreme Brahman is described as consisting of Brahman-knowledge.
The supreme Brahman is likewise described as consisting of Brahman-bliss.
These attributes are declared directly to the goddess.
inference: The supreme Brahman is essentially constituted of both Brahman-knowledge and Brahman-bliss.
uncertainties: The grammatical case of the -maya compounds is taken as neuter nominative singular in apposition with the previously described supreme Brahman.
plain_english: O goddess, it is likewise consisting of the knowledge of Brahman and the bliss of Brahman.
